name: vijil
description: Ship trusted agents from Claude Code. Inspect the agent you're building free, local, no account — then evaluate it fully with black-box adversarial evaluation via Vijil Diamond — root-cause the failures, and protect (Dome) or adapt (Darwin) them; register it to track its trust over time.
